Check for expected FASTQ files in a directory

Source: R/count_sgRNA.R
check_fastq_files.Rd

This function checks if all expected FASTQ files are present in the specified directory based on provided timepoints and treatments.

Usage

check_fastq_files(
  timepoints = c("T0", "T4", "T10", "T14"),
  treatments = c("DMSO", "FGF401"),
  fastq_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

timepoints

A character vector of timepoints to check (default is c("T0","T4","T10","T14")).

treatments

A character vector of treatments to check (default is c("DMSO","FGF401")).

fastq_dir

A character string specifying the directory containing the FASTQ files.

Value

None. The function stops execution if any expected FASTQ files are missing.
